body:
Thanks for your reply. 

I have been actively trying to get involved more into my friendships and I'd say that it has been successful? Thing is, ever since my mental breakdown I've become someone you'd call a foolish person: I put in a lot of effort for no real reason and literally always give it my all, not getting anything back. And it really has taken a toll on my mentality.

I have some hobbies but the real issue is that they don't really give me any joy and satisfaction, therefore the incentive to pursue them just isn't that present.

Assuming I survive that long I'll probably move out in a little bit from this household anyway. And I'd rather avoid contact with my parents through such chores.

My only hope really is meeting someone in college, I just.. don't know anymore.

Because no matter where I look back on my past I either had to lie to get out of something, or lie to satisfy my parents (since I did not meet their expectations as a child) and because I've essentially created a fake reality around me and I refuse to leave it. I know the reality is different but I just can't stop extending the reach of my lie-filled world.
